description: Self-hosted Renovate (run-llama/platform renovate.yml). charts/llamacloud is the BYOC chart customers install, so every chart change waits for approval on the dependency dashboard and ships only with a chart version bump, a changelog entry and the 10-day customer notice. Nothing automerges here: this repo has no automated reviewer.

packageRules.description: The BYOC chart ships to customer installs: every dependency and image update waits for approval
prBodyNotes: BYOC chart: bump the llamacloud chart version and CHANGELOG in this PR; tenants upgrade after the 10-day customer notice.

packageRules.description: Temporal server: the subchart and the admin-tools image move together, one minor at a time (schema migration on every install)
Runtime versions (setup-python and friends) wait for approval
